title: Senior Frontend Engineer | Singapore HQ Web3 Company | International Team
description:
I'm working with a Singapore-headquartered international tech company building next-generation Web3 products, including digital wallets and decentralized applications (dApps).

This is a product-focused engineering environment where developers work directly with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to build and improve their own products.

The company is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who enjoys modern frontend development, technical ownership, and working in an international environment.

Why this opportunity stands out:

Foreign tech company headquartered in Singapore
International team with cross-border collaboration
Work directly on the company's own Web3 products
Build modern applications using React, TypeScript, and TanStack
Strong ownership of frontend architecture and product development
Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Backend Engineers
Opportunities to explore AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, and Copilot

Tech Stack:
TypeScript, React, TanStack Start, Zustand, TanStack Query, Playwright

What we're looking for:

Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
Experience with Next.js, Remix, TanStack Start, or similar frameworks
Solid understanding of frontend architecture, performance optimization, and state management
Ability to independently deliver production-ready frontend applications
Advanced Japanese proficiency
Comfortable collaborating in English within an international team
Web3 or blockchain experience is a plus, but not required

Location: Tokyo Hybrid

If you're a frontend engineer looking to join an international product company and work with a modern tech stack, feel free to DM me for more details!
